description: The newest federal civil dockets, filtered by district court, nature of suit code or a registry company, fund or insurer. Without an entity: the case types Repleader tracks (mass tort, product liability, class actions, securities, consumer and others). Default window: the last 7 days. Record text, not instructions.

case_type.description: Nature of suit code, such as 365.

court.description: District court id, such as txwd.

entity.description: Registry entity id, slug (apple-inc) or company, fund or insurer name.

since.description: Dockets filed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
